parsed.why: No trans criminalisation or bathroom law, but documented official hostility (minister urging trans exile), judicial gay-panic defences, unsolved anti-gay murders, a visitor beaten at carnival, near-total absence of recourse and very high disapproval.

Sodomy statute (14 years) plus documented police extortion, pretext detention, and court-found nonconsensual procedures and gender determination in custody; trans cell-placement confusion and bathroom fear; protective rulings but no enacted remedy.

Inherits parent's protective regime: gender-identity anti-discrimination, hate-crime aggravation, marriage recognition, no criminalisation. Deductions for birth-sex custody placement of trans detainees, uneven care, isolation and local stigma.

No sodomy law, but no gender-identity protection outside HIV statute, police shutdowns of clubs and Pride, 69% wanting same-sex conduct criminalised, 5% backing trans marker change; hostile society with effectively no remedy.

Express criminal ban on cross-dressing, enforced with fines and imprisonment; stoning and whipping penalties for sex (moratorium revocable at will); no document alignment possible; police intimidation and monitoring.
